about: Launches for zig/kernels/metal/ops: each entry point is bit-identical to the MLX 0.32.3 kernel named in 'mlx' at the shapes in 'nemotron' (checked by tools/zig/check_mlx_ops.py).

compile.note: MLX's options for its run-time kernels; a library built offline is a different compiler build

binding: buffer(i) in signature order (inputs, then outputs); inputs declared 'constant' take setBytes or a small buffer; small P/SHAPE/BATCH arrays are int32/int64/float as declared
grid: 'threads' grids go to dispatchThreads, 'threadgroups' grids to dispatchThreadgroups, with the given threadgroup
devices: rules marked 's' are the M5 Max's (applegpu_g17s); MLX picks other tiles or block counts on 'd' (Ultra) and base chips, given under 'other_devices'

tf_embed_b{4,6,8}_g64.io: IDS u32 [>= 8, padded], TABLE u8 [V, D bits/8], S, B bf16 [V, D/64], P i32 [D] -> OUT bf16 [R, D]
tf_embed_b{4,6,8}_g64.launch: threads [D / values a unit (2 at 4-bit, 4 at 6-bit, 1 at 8-bit), R, 1], threadgroup [256, 1, 1]

tf_rms_norm_bf16.mlx: rmsbfloat16 = rms_single_row<bf16, 4> (D <= 4096): layer 0's input norm and every MTP norm
tf_rms_norm_bf16.io: X bf16 [R, D], W bf16 [D], EPS f32[1], DIM i32[1] -> OUT bf16 [R, D]
tf_rms_norm_bf16.launch: threads [T R, 1, 1], threadgroup [T, 1, 1], T = 32 ceil(ceil(D / 4) / 32) (672 at D 2688)

tf_embed_rms_b4_g64.mlx: the decode prologue: gather_front x3 + affine_dequantize + rmsbfloat16 in one launch
tf_embed_rms_b4_g64.io: IDS u32 [>= 8], TABLE u8, S, B bf16, W bf16 [D], EPS f32[1], DIM i32[1] -> H bf16 [R, D] (residual), OUT bf16 [R, D] (normed)

io.qmv, qmv_fast: W u32 [N, K bits/32], S, B bf16 [N, K/64], X bf16 [M, K], SHAPE i32 [K, N] -> Y bf16 [M, N]
io.gather_qmv: W [E, N, K bits/32], S, B [E, N, K/64], X [rows, K], IDS u32 [>= 8] (expert per output row), XIDS u32 [>= 8] (input row per output row), SHAPE [K, N] -> Y [outputs, N]; MLX's fast gather (K % 512 == 0 at 4-bit) is not built: no Nemotron expert shape reaches it

mlx_rule.M = 1: qmv_fast when N % 8 == 0 and K % (32 x 2 x values a pack) == 0, else qmv
mlx_rule.2 <= M < limit (gen >= 15): qmv_wide, nv = ceil(M / ceil(M / 5)); gen 13-14 run qmv rows
mlx_rule.limit on 's' (gen 17): 33 when K, N <= 2048; 25 when <= 4096; 13 otherwise; M >= limit runs qmm_splitk (not here)

tf_sdpa_2p1_d128.launch: threadgroups [KVH, B, blocks] of [32, gqa, R]

tf_sdpa_2p1_d128_cqt.launch: threadgroups [KVH, B, blocks] of [32, gqa, R]

sdpa.metal.io: Q bf16 (the projection's memory: [1, R, H, 128]; row-contiguous [B, H, R, 128] when R = 1), K, V bf16 cache [B, KVH, cap, 128], P i32 (vec: [gqa, keys]; pass 1: [keys, blocks]; pass 2: [blocks]), ST i64 [k_head, k_seq, v_head, v_seq] strides in elements, SC f32 [scale] -> O bf16 [B, H, R, 128]; pass 1 writes PART bf16 [B H R, blocks, 128], SUMS, MAXS f32 [B H R, blocks]

mlx_rule.fused: R <= 8 and R x gqa <= 32 (Nemotron: R <= 2); otherwise the unfused fallback (see nax_gemm.metal)
mlx_rule.2-pass: 's' and 'd' devices: keys >= 1024; others: keys >= 4096 with GQA
mlx_rule.blocks on 's': 64; when keys > 1024 and gqa R > 4: 128 to 8192 keys, 256 to 32768, 512 to 65536, else 1024
mlx_rule.gqa16 pass 1: R 1, no mask, D = V = 128, gqa 16, keys >= 8192
mlx_rule.other_devices: 'd': 128, 256 when gqa R <= 2 and keys > 8192, 512 / 1024 for gqa R >= 6 at 16384+ / 65536+; base: 64 if gqa R >= 4 else 32

tf_argmax_part_bf16 + tf_argmax_merge.mlx: argmax_bfloat16 (arg_reduce_general): the same index (first NaN, else the lowest index of the max)
tf_argmax_part_bf16 + tf_argmax_merge.launch: part: threadgroups [ceil(V / span), R, 1] of [256, 1, 1], P [V, span] (span 2048); merge: threadgroups [1, R, 1] of [32, 1, 1], P [spans]
tf_argmax_part_bf16 + tf_argmax_merge.io: part: X bf16 [R, V] -> PV f32, PI u32 [R, spans]; merge -> IDX u32 [R]

tf_gemv_bf16_tm4.mlx: gemv_bfloat16_bm1_bn8_sm1_sn32_tm4_tn4_nc0_axpby0 (x @ W.T with K >= 16 N, N >= 4): the MTP router gate
tf_gemv_bf16_tm4.io: MAT bf16 [N, ld], VEC bf16 [K], P i32 [K, N, ld] -> OUT bf16 [N]

tf_gemv_wide_bf16_v{3,4,5}_kl32.io: MAT bf16 rows (keys), X bf16 vectors, P i32 [K, N, M, mat_ld, x_ld], BATCH i64 [inner, x outer/inner strides, mat outer/inner strides] -> OUT bf16 [batch, M, N]
tf_gemv_wide_bf16_v{3,4,5}_kl32.mlx_rule: passes = ceil(M / 5) <= 3, nv = ceil(M / passes), grid_x = passes (1 when N >= 65536); kl 32 when passes == 1 or N <= 64, else 16, which at K = 128 (the head dim) gives kl 32's bits
tf_gemv_wide_bf16_v{3,4,5}_kl32.note: only R = 3-8 query rows reach the unfused attention; R 2 is fused (sdpa.metal)

tf_softmax_bf16.io: X bf16 [rows, n], P i32 [n] -> OUT bf16

tf_route_topk.mlx: all of mlx-lm's compiled group_expert_select (n_group 1): the Sigmoid fusion, the -(p + bias) fusion, carg_block_sort_float32_uint32_bn32_tn4, gather_axis, row_reduce_small_1_reduce_sumfloat32 and the normalise-and-scale fusion
tf_route_topk.io: G bf16 [R, E] gates, BIAS f32 [E], C f32 [1e-20, routed_scaling_factor], P i32 [E, k] -> IDS u32 [R, k], WT f32 [R, k]
tf_route_topk.launch: threads [E, R, 1], threadgroup [E, 1, 1] (E 128): one threadgroup a row

elementwise.metal.tf_scale_bf16: sv_Multiplybfloat16 (bf16(scale) x q in the unfused attention)
elementwise.metal.tf_moe_combine: v_copybfloat16float32 + g2_Multiplyfloat32 + col_reduce_small_1_reduce_sumfloat32 + v_copyfloat32bfloat16 in one launch (one row, k <= 7 weights)
elementwise.metal.tf_causal_mask_bf16: arangeint32 x2 + g2_GreaterEqualint32 + g2_Selectbfloat16: where(q >= k, s, lowest bf16)
elementwise.metal.launch: threads [count, 1, 1] (mask: [n, R, batch]; combine: [D, rows, 1]), threadgroup [256, 1, 1] or fewer

tf_nax_gemm_nn_bf16.mlx: steel_gemm_fused_nax_nn_bfloat16_bfloat16_bm64_bn128_bk256_wm2_wn4 (has_batch, align_M false, align_N true, align_K false): the MTP's P @ V for 3-8 query rows
tf_nax_gemm_nn_bf16.io: A bf16 [batch, M, K] (lda), B bf16 [K, N] (ldb), P i32 [M, N, K, lda, ldb, ldd], BATCH i64 [inner, A outer/inner, B outer/inner strides, D stride] -> D bf16
tf_nax_gemm_nn_bf16.note: each 16x32 output fragment runs MPP matmul2d(16, 32, 16, relaxed) over 2 ceil(K / 32) 16-wide K chunks in order, as MLX's 's' tile (bk 256, or 64 from K >= 8192) and its other tiles all do

nax_gemm.metal.fallback chain (R x gqa > 32, R <= 8): tf_scale_bf16 -> tf_gemv_wide_bf16_v{nv}_kl32 -> tf_causal_mask_bf16 -> tf_softmax(_looped)_bf16 -> tf_nax_gemm_nn_bf16; equals mx.fast.scaled_dot_product_attention there

not_covered.pre-M5 multi-row attention: R 3-8 on chips without tensor units runs MLX's steel (simdgroup MMA) GEMM, not built here
not_covered.R > 8 MTP rows: steel_attention / NAX attention and qmm_splitk / qmm_nax: the prefill agent's kernels
not_covered.layout copies: the Zig engine stores layouts directly (lead)
